newsitem.title: GERMANY: New terminals for Uruguay under privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: New terminals for Uruguay under privatisation plan.

text.p: Uruguay plans to build new cargo and passenger terminals at Montevideo's Carrasco International Airport under privatisation plans, an international consulting group said on Monday.

The country's gateway airport should be handed over to private investors under a build-operate-transfer scheme (BOT) by the beginning of 1999, Lufthansa Consulting GmbH said in a statement issued here.
The Deutsche Lufthansa AG subsidiary said it and Coopers & Lybrand, Germany, would be advising the Uruguayan government task force on development of a privatisation strategy.
"The master plan for Carrasco Airport includes the construction of new passenger and cargo terminals and the enhancement of the runways and aprons," the Lufthansa statement added.
No details of the construction schedule or the size of the planned terminals were given.

In February, the Uruguayan government announced that a new international airport would be built at a cost of up to 600 million dollars alongside Carrasco International Airport, which dates back to 1948. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017 - www.racs.com
